data.dax_query:
EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    'Finance Orders'[region],
    "Sum of sales", [Sum of sales],
    "Sum of sales_target", [Sum of sales_target],
    "Target Attainment", [Target Attainment]
)
ORDER BY 'Finance Orders'[region]

EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    'Finance Orders'[Fiscal Year],
    "Sum of sales", [Sum of sales],
    "Projected Sales", [Projected Sales],
    "Sales YoY Prior", [Sales YoY Prior],
    "Avg Monthly Sales", [Avg Monthly Sales]
)
ORDER BY 'Finance Orders'[Fiscal Year]

EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    'Finance Orders'[Order Size],
    'Finance Orders'[segment],
    KEEPFILTERS(TREATAS({"Consumer", "Corporate"}, 'Finance Orders'[segment])),
    "Count of order_id", [Count of order_id],
    "Margin %", [Margin %],
    "Loss Orders", [Loss Orders],
    "Max Order Value", [Max Order Value]
)
ORDER BY 'Finance Orders'[Order Size], 'Finance Orders'[segment]

EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    'Finance Orders'[Region Code],
    "Sum of profit", [Sum of profit]
)
ORDER BY 'Finance Orders'[Region Code]
